admission.justification: Background polling would add avoidable live-agent census work while no pane consumes it.

applicability: Periodic tree-chat preload requests and their browser visibility lifetime.
conditions: Both chat pane and tab are shown for polling.
Hiding cancels the pending request/timer; showing refreshes immediately only if the retained answer is 30 seconds old.
exclusions: Fresh selected-document authority reads are distinct from the periodic tree preload.

evidence: dashboard/src/cockpit/document-chat/knownChats.test.tsx › "asks nothing while the browser's tab or the chat pane is hidden, and once when it is shown again", "gives up a request that is under way when the tab is hidden, and leaves no timer behind"

statement: The tree's chats are not asked for while the browser's tab or the chat pane is hidden; shown again, they are asked for at once only when the last answer is 30 s old, and nothing is left running.
